name: Root Cause Analysis
title: The RCA round, drilled: structured debugging under pressure, not lucky guesses.
lede: A mock focused on root-cause questions — 'engagement dropped 15% overnight', 'users are churning, find out why'. We run a realistic prompt, then I show you how to isolate the problem with a clean hypothesis tree instead of scattering guesses.
reassure: 100% money-back guarantee — if it isn't useful, tell me and I'll refund it in full.
forYou: Facing a root-cause or 'diagnose the drop' round soon
Guessing randomly instead of narrowing systematically
Struggling to structure hypotheses under time pressure
Forgetting to separate internal from external causes
Wanting a repeatable method for any diagnosis prompt
notForYou: You want a product sense or strategy round instead
You haven't mapped which rounds you need (start with a strategy session)
You want written feedback, not a live mock

howItWorks.d: Checkout in your local currency and you'll be handed straight to booking.
Pick a slot and share your target role and level.
A realistic root-cause prompt, timed, on Google Meet — you diagnose as if it's the real round.
We break down your approach and I show you how to build and prune a clean hypothesis tree.

deliverables: A repeatable structure for any 'why did this happen' prompt
A clean way to separate internal, external, and data causes
A method for narrowing hypotheses quickly and out loud
Honest feedback on where your diagnosis wandered
The specific fixes to practice before the real round

faq.a: Whether you can take a vague 'something's wrong' prompt and drive to a likely cause methodically — forming hypotheses, isolating variables, and clarifying assumptions instead of guessing.

faq.q: Isn't this the same as the metrics round?
faq.a: They overlap, but RCA is specifically about diagnosis under ambiguity — the structured debugging process — while the metrics round leans more on defining and choosing measures. This session drills the diagnosis muscle.

faq.q: Will you give me a framework?
faq.a: You'll leave with a reusable structure for isolating causes, but the emphasis is on applying it flexibly and thinking out loud clearly, which is what interviewers score.

finalCta.title: Diagnose like an engineer, communicate like a PM.
finalCta.sub: Book a focused mock and leave with a structure for any RCA prompt.
